title: Puttanesca
summary: A flavourful italian sauce which is rich, tomatoey, and salty...
extendedSummary: A flavourful italian sauce which is rich, tomatoey, and salty from the olives, capers and anchovies. This is such a simple sauce, and is pretty healthy all things considered. Must be paired with parmasen, otherwise the dish is literally ruined.

items: Some olive oil for the pan
1 small jar of pitted kalamata olives

method: Heat the oil in a fry pan, and add finely chopped onions and cook until nice and caramelised
Add grated garlic and chilli flakes and fry for another minute or two
Next add tomatoes, capers, and chopped anchovies (with a splash of anchovy oil for flavour)
Lower the heat and simmer for 15 mins
Add olives and parsley, season with salt and pepper
